## Computer Use

Control native apps and browsers on the user’s computer by reading or operating UI. Prefer purpose-built connectors, APIs, or CLIs when available.

- Use `cua_repl` (JavaScript) for all UI actions.
- Do not use other technologies besides `cua_repl` for computer interactions, unless specifically requested by the user (e.g. AppleScript, `osascript`, JXA, System Events, CGEvent synthesis).
- Prefer a dedicated plugin or skill when it can complete the task; use Computer Use for interactions that are not exposed through a more specific interface.
- `cua_repl` state is persistent across calls
- If you create a tab or get an app, the initial UI state is automatically included in the tool result.

};

  click(target: number | Vec2, options?: ClickOptions): Promise<void>;
  drag(from: Vec2, to: Vec2): Promise<void>;
  pressKey(key: string): Promise<void>;
  scroll(target: number | Vec2, direction: Direction, pages?: number): Promise<void>;
  selectText(elementIndex: number, text: string, options?: SelectTextOptions): Promise<void>;

}

It is rendered per-host\n— the \"What's enabled on THIS machine\" section reflects what the user actually\nselected at init.\n\n## Orientation (read this first)\n\n- **Repo root**: `chezmoi source-path` (no args) prints the source dir. Work there\n  to edit: `cd \"$(chezmoi source-path)\"`.\n- **Source path of one file**: `chezmoi source-path ~/.config/foo/bar` → the\n  managed source file for that target.\n- **`docs/**` is NOT deployed to `$HOME`** (it's chezmoi-ignored). Read detail via\n  `\"$(chezmoi source-path)/docs/...\"`. A *subset* is deployed to `~/.config/docs/`\n  (e.g. keybindings, cli-tools) for runtime helpers.\n- **Read the contract before editing**: `\"$(chezmoi source-path)/CLAUDE.md\"` holds\n  Hard invariants and cross-file maintenance rules. 可以一起整理成 **Personal tools**，先涵蓋七個獨立 CLI：`dev`、`translate`、`exp` 和四個 `lazy*`。

目前最省維護的做法，是保留 macOS 已有的 Homebrew 管道，其他工具先沿用 `go install`。lazyclash 雖然已有 `v0.1.7` release，但還沒有 binary assets 或 Homebrew formula，所以現在切換管道沒有收益。之後有穩定的預編譯發佈，再替換安裝來源即可。

對，會沿用你現有的 [homebrew-tap](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/homebrew-tap)。目前裡面只有 `dev-cli.rb`、`translate.rb`，還沒有集中同步 workflow。

對七個工具來說，集中管理比較容易維護：工具 repo 各自發布 binary；tap 定時或手動讀取公開 release、驗證 checksum 後更新 formula。這也避免把可寫 tap 的密鑰複製到五個新 repo。代價是自動同步有排程延遲，首次發行可立即手動觸發。[GitHub Token 權限說明](https://goreleaser.com/customization/ci/actions/)

兩個 CI 阻礙也已釐清：chezmoi 上游已換 module path；exp 的失敗則已用單一測試重現，修 canonical temporary HOME 即可，無須放寬正式程式的 symlink 檢查。

Existing dotfiles-owned commands such as `fleet` and\n+`mlf` retain their current distribution.\n+\n+## Enable or disable\n+\n+```sh\n+dotcfg --set installPersonalTools=true --yes --no-apply\n+# Inspect the resulting configuration, then run your normal apply workflow.\n+```\n+\n+Use `false` to stop managed installation. Disabling does not uninstall existing\n+binaries, stop services, or disable capability-based runtime integrations.\n+The suite never installs itself on first invocation. SDK。成功後只刷新該工具的 Bash／Zsh completion。下載、checksum、版本驗證\n+失敗時保留舊 binary，不改走另一個安裝管道。\n+\n+`just upgrade-go` 改為非 personal Go 工具（目前 Linux gopls）。Personal formula\n+不放通用 Brewfile，避免 `upgrade-brew` 的 `brew bundle` 補回被刪除的工具；一般\n+`brew upgrade` 仍可更新已安裝 formula，安裝開關不是版本凍結開關。\n+\n+## 發行與維護\n+\n+各應用 repo 發佈自己的 binary；tap 定時或手動讀取 stable public release，驗證\n+完整產物與 checksum 後更新有變動的 formula。不完整或不一致的 release 保留舊\n+formula。這樣不必替每個應用 repo 都配置 tap-write token。\n+\n+工具新增／移除時，同步 registry、兩語言 tool inventory、upgrade 文件、completion\n+與 chezmoi agent skill。只有刻意提高新機基線時才改 pin；一般升級跟隨現有 owner\n+的 latest stable release。\n+\n+## 驗證\n+\n+```sh\n+bats tests/unit/personal_tools.bats tests/unit/lazyclash_setup.bats\n+just gen-prompts --check\n+just ansible-syntax-check\n+just docs-build\n+```\n+\n+Fixtures 驗證選擇與舊機遷移、owner、失敗保留、原子替換／回復及 Ansible check\n+mode，不執行全機安裝。英文版另列七個 package／binary 名稱與用途。\n*** End Patch"));

## 2. Search results

Query: `site.fishshell.com/docs/3.7 language redirections command substitutions file descriptors`

**The fish language — fish-shell 3.7.1 documentation**

- **File descriptors and redirection:** Standard input, output, and error use descriptors 0, 1, and 2. Numbered redirections use `N<DESTINATION`, `N>DESTINATION`, or `N>>DESTINATION_FILE`. A destination such as `&2` refers to another descriptor; `&-` closes a descriptor. The documentation states that redirecting a builtin, function, or block to a descriptor above 2 is an error, whereas external commands support it. ([fishshell.com](https://fishshell.com/docs/3.7/language.html?utm_source=openai))
- **Evaluation order:** Pipes are established first, then redirections are evaluated left to right. Consequently, `>&2` redirects stdout to stderr’s destination at that point in evaluation. ([fishshell.com](https://fishshell.com/docs/3.7/language.html?utm_source=openai))
- **Command substitution:** `(command)` and `$(command)` capture the command’s stdout for use as arguments. The inner command completes before the outer command starts. Unquoted output is normally split on newlines. The `$(command)` form also works inside double quotes, where output is not split into separate arguments by line, although trailing empty lines are removed. A final `string split` or `string split0` controls splitting instead of the normal newline behavior. ([fishshell.com](https://fishshell.com/docs/3.7/language.html?utm_source=openai))

終端驗收。\n \n+Startup harness 使用一次性 fixture，刻意讓 status 延遲五秒，驗證清單、Source 預覽與操作先就緒，並分別回報畫面、可用清單、預覽及完整 status 的時間與 native command 次數。這些時間取決於機器與資料量；不對真實 dotfiles 執行 apply。\n+\n 程式分成 `internal/chezmoi`（共享操作／hunk snapshots）、`internal/diffview`（delta／內建 renderer）、`internal/search`（rg／結果預覽）、`internal/tui`（模型／action registry／共用 layout）、`internal/cli`（命令介面）、`internal/config` 與 `internal/shell`。介面建立不執行 I/O；非同步結果依 request generation 接受，寫入結束後重新取得狀態。\n \n ### Source distribution size\n"}

**Windows 目前只接入兩個：**

| 工具 | Windows 安裝設定 |
|---|---|
| `dev-cli` | 隨 `installHerdr=true` 安裝；Herdr 預設關閉。下載官方 Windows binary，以 `dev-cli.exe` 避免與公司的 `dev` 撞名 |
| `translate` | `installTranslate=true` 時透過 Scoop 安裝；workstation 預設開啟 |
| `exp`、四個 `lazy*` | 尚未加入安裝流程 |

依據是 [Windows 安裝腳本](/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dotfiles-windows/.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl:668)。Windows 尚無 `installPersonalTools`；我也確認其餘五個工具的最新 release 都還沒有 Windows 預編譯包。

因此要對齊 Windows，需先補各工具的 Windows 發布與驗證，再加入 personal-tools 開關，並讓 `dev-cli` 能獨立於 Herdr 安裝。

另外，你這台 Mac 的 `lazychezmoi`、`lazymlflow`、`lazypueue` 仍是 **v0.1.0**。`chezmoi apply` 只負責安裝，批次升級走 `just upgrade-personal`。本次僅檢查，沒有執行升級，也未登入 Windows 主機確認實機狀態。
